title: CandidateSearchDocument
description: Denormalized OpenSearch document representing an opted-in candidate for recruiter resume-database search. Source of truth is `candidate_profiles` (and derived tables) in `candidate-service`. Document id = candidate_id. Tenant + consent filters are mandatory at query time.

candidate_id.description: Candidate profile id. Equals OpenSearch document _id.

tenant_id.description: Owning tenant for tenant-imported candidates. NULL for marketplace-only candidates (in which case `tenants_visible_to` controls per-tenant visibility).

tenants_visible_to.description: When `profile_visibility=TENANT_ONLY`, this list enumerates tenants permitted to see the candidate (typically tenants the candidate has applied to). Mandatory join filter applied by gateway.

profile_visibility.description: PRIVATE candidates are NOT indexed (the projector removes them); the value is included in the schema for safety and to support transitional states.

consent_searchable.description: Mandatory: gateway adds `term consent_searchable=true` to every candidate query.

consent_recorded_at.description: Timestamp of the most recent consent grant; used to enforce SLO on revocation propagation.

email.description: Included only when consent allows recruiter contact.

phone.description: Included only when consent allows recruiter contact.

education.description: Nested for term-level filters per education row.

currency.description: ISO-4217 currency code for salary expectation.

resume_text.description: Plain text extracted from the candidate's default resume by resume-parser-worker. Limited length (~50KB) to keep indices small; long resumes are truncated with the original stored in S3.

profile_vector.description: Optional dense embedding for hybrid kNN. Length must match index mapping (matches embedding_vector_metadata.dim).
